label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Austin Gaugert's Caddie Return
items.text: Austin Gaugert is caddying for Dylan Wu at the Charles Schwab Challenge two weeks after his PGA Championship penalty mishap with Garrick Higgo, who has switched to a new caddie.

items.headline: Tiger Woods Skips 2026 Majors
items.text: Tiger Woods is not expected to play any majors in 2026, raising questions about the future of his competitive major career.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau Backs LIV Team Play
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau tied for the lead at LIV Golf Korea and praised the team format, while also warning that reducing pro events could harm top player status amid LIV's funding uncertainty.
